text: A lot of Veridian's data has nobody's name on it. When something's wrong with a number, nobody knows who's supposed to answer for it.
We fixed that with a RACI matrix across three domains -- Customer, Financial, Product and Inventory -- naming a business owner and a technical steward for each one.
The owner is accountable for what the data should mean. The steward is responsible for the pipeline that keeps it correct day to day. Different questions, different people.
Those exact names are entered directly into Purview's Contacts tab on every registered source and on the Active Customer glossary term itself.
We audited for gaps and found none. Every domain now has a real person to ask. Next: protecting the personal data those owners are accountable for.
